name: dng100_100hz
what: every DNg100 cell kicked by an independent 100 Hz Poisson train from 300 to 1300 ms, as scripts/probes/command_walk.py --type DNg100 --hz 100 does
evidence: DNg100 (BDN2) activation drives forward walking: optogenetic activation in flies (Bidaye et al. 2020) and rhythmic front-leg motor output in VNC connectome simulations confirmed optogenetically (Pugliese et al. 2025, bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.09.12.675944). The kick stands in for the optogenetic drive; its size is the profile's kick_mv
